title: Hazie ụbọchị mmepụta, na-ere n'enweghị nsogbu, nweta asambodo gị

say: Hazie ụbọchị mmepụta, ree n'enweghị nsogbu, wee nweta asambodo gị.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul anọ nke Basic Baking and Snacks Production.
Ihe nzuzo nke ụbọchị mmepụta dị jụụ na-eme atụmatụ azụ site na oge nnyefe. Dee oge, ebe, na ogologo oge njem ahụ na-ewe.

say: Nye oge maka oyi na mbukota. Nri na-ekpo ọkụ ga-ajụrịrị tupu ị mechie igbe.

say: Gụkwuo oven gị gburugburu ma ọ bụ batches frying, na ogologo oge nke ọ bụla na-ewe.

say: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Halima dị n'Abuja ga-ebuga anụ achịcha iri ise na 100 puff-puff na elekere 10:30 nke ụtụtụ na Satọde. Na Fraịdee, ọ na-azụ ahịa, na-enyocha ọkwa gas ya, na-esi nri nju. Ọ na-ajụkwa ya ma tinye ya n'ime friji n'ime awa 2, ma tụọ ihe ndị kpọrọ nkụ n'ime akpa akara.

say: Nlebanya mbufe adịgboroja na nseta ihuenyo adịgboroja na-adịkarị. Ahapụla ngwa ahịa n'ihi SMS ma ọ bụ nseta ihuenyo naanị. Mepee ụlọ akụ ma ọ bụ ngwa ego mkpanaka gị wee gosi na ego ahụ dị na nguzozi gị.

Ekekọrịtala PIN, paswọọdụ ma ọ bụ koodu otu oge, ọbụlagodi na onye kwuru na ha si n'ụlọ akụ gị. Maka nnukwu iwu ihe omume, rịọ maka nkwụnye ego, dịka ọmụmaatụ 50%, tupu ịzụrụ ihe. Ma debe ego azụmaahịa na akaụntụ dị iche.

panel.heading: Nchekwa ịkwụ ụgwọ
items: Ekwela ka ahapụ ngwaahịa na SMS ma ọ bụ nseta ihuenyo
Ekekọrịtala PIN gị ma ọ bụ koodu otu oge
Nkwụnye ego maka nnukwu iwu, dịka ọmụmaatụ 50%

say: Kwa izu, a na-ere nkeji egwu, na-efunahụ uru, na-emeghachi ndị ahịa. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, n'ime izu mbụ, a na-eme iberibe 200 ma ree 176.
200 mwepu 176 doo 24 ereghị ma ọ bụ jụ.
24 kewara site na 200 bụ 0.12.
Gbanwee site na 100, na mkpofu bụ 12%. N'ime izu atọ n'ime ihe atụ, mkpofu na-adaba na 5% ma na-emeghachi ndị ahịa na-ebili na 12. Nke ahụ na-egosi àgwà na atụmatụ na-akawanye mma.

panel.heading: Na-arụ ọrụ mkpofu%
panel.rule: Ịda n'efu na ịrị elu ndị ahịa na-aga n'ihu pụtara ọganihu

say: Pọtụfoliyo gị na-egosi ezigbo omume. Ezi ntụziaka abụọ n'ime gram, foto ndị doro anya doro anya, ndekọ batch, mpempe akwụkwọ na-eri ọnụ, akara nwere ihe nrịanrịa, ọnụ ọgụgụ na-atọ ụtọ na echiche ziri ezi. Tinye nsogbu yana otu i siri dozie ha.
Mgbe ahụ, atụmatụ ụbọchị 90, na ngwaahịa, ndị ahịa na ọnụọgụ ole na ole. Iji nweta asambodo, mezue oru ngo a wee nweta opekata mpe 70% na ajụjụ ikpeazụ.

panel.heading: Pọtụfoliyo na atụmatụ ụbọchị 90
items: Ezi ntụziaka abụọ ọkọlọtọ na gram
Mpempe akwụkwọ na-akwụ ụgwọ na akara akara

say: Omume gị: hazie ma mee usoro nke opekata mpe 30, wuo ngwa ahịa gị, rute otu ụlọ akwụkwọ, ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa, wee dee echiche gị na atụmatụ ụbọchị iri itoolu.
Ugbu a gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.

panel.heading: Ugbu a ị na-agbalị
items: Hazie ma mee otu usoro nke 30 iberibe
Gakwuru otu ụlọ akwụkwọ, ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ ahịa
Dee echiche gị na atụmatụ ụbọchị 90
